==Notes==
*The maximum healing limit refers to the total amount of healing through the skill, not just the bonus.
*When a [[miniature]] is present, it counts as an ally and the user will gain additional healing.
*With 0 Leadership, 11 allies are needed to get the maximum of 140 health. At 12 Leadership, only 5 allies are needed.
{{bug|Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not [[health gain]].}}
